title.narrative: Support for Emergency Repairs of Schools in Ukraine

description.narrative: The ongoing conflict has led to the destruction of much of the country’s infrastructure. This includes public buildings and schools, putting the rights of millions of children to a quality education at risk.\nAs part of the European Commission’s wider allocation of €100 million to rehabilitate schools across Ukraine, UNOPS has partnered with the EU to implement a €20 million project that aims to provide safe and accessible learning environments to more than 20,000 students and carry out emergency repairs of over 40 schools across the country.
